source: 李白《長干行》其一 (30 verse-lines, Wikisource text of record via corpus/tang_en/zh_source/li_bai_changgan_xing.txt) ↔ Ezra Pound, Cathay (1915), 'The River-Merchant's Wife: a Letter' (title + 30 body lines, Gutenberg #50155, corpus/tang_en/raw/pound_cathay_1915.txt line 149).

map.note: 妾髮初覆額 ↔ 'While my hair was still cut straight across my forehead'
折花門前劇 ↔ 'I played about the front gate, pulling flowers.'
郎騎竹馬來 ↔ 'You came by on bamboo stilts, playing horse,'
遶牀弄青梅 ↔ 'You walked about my seat, playing with blue plums.' — NB 青梅 rendered 'blue plums' (青 → blue); a separate colour SURVIVAL, not the target.
同居長干里 ↔ 'And we went on living in the village of Chokan:'
兩小無嫌猜 ↔ 'Two small people, without dislike or suspicion.'
十四爲君婦 ↔ 'At fourteen I married My Lord you.'
羞顏未甞開 ↔ 'I never laughed, being bashful.'
低頭向暗壁 ↔ 'Lowering my head, I looked at the wall.'
千喚不一回 ↔ 'Called to, a thousand times, I never looked back.'
十五始展眉 ↔ 'At fifteen I stopped scowling,'
願同塵與灰 ↔ 'I desired my dust to be mingled with yours'
常存抱柱信 ↔ 'Forever and forever, and forever.'
豈上望夫臺 ↔ 'Why should I climb the look out?'
十六君遠行 ↔ 'At sixteen you departed,'
瞿塘灩澦堆 ↔ 'You went into far Ku-to-Yen, by the river of swirling eddies,'
五月不可觸 ↔ 'And you have been gone five months.'
猿聲天上哀 ↔ 'The monkeys make sorrowful noise overhead.'
門前遲行跡 ↔ 'You dragged your feet when you went out.'

TARGET. 一一生綠苔 ↔ 'By the gate now, the moss is grown, the different mosses,' — the crossing of interest on the COLOUR axis: zh 綠 (green) STATED × Pound names moss but no hue-word ('green' does not appear). Clean positional 1:1 for the target line. Measured honestly (see registration): the descriptive en colour labeler charges 'moss' itself as an xkcd colour term, so the crossing is NOT the expected DEFORMATION.
苔深不能掃 ↔ 'Too deep to clear them away!'
落葉秋風早 ↔ 'The leaves fall early this autumn, in wind.'

八月胡蝶來 ↔ 'The paired butterflies are already yellow with August' — NB 'yellow' here is Pound's addition (八月 = August); a colour on the seat that has no zh colour graph on this line (an INVENTION row), not the target.
雙飛西園草 ↔ 'Over the grass in the West garden,'
感此傷妾心 ↔ 'They hurt me,'
坐愁紅顏老 ↔ 'I grow older,' — NB zh 紅顏 (紅 = red, the 'rosy face' of youth) has no colour word in Pound's compression; a possible colour DEFORMATION row, not the target.
早晚下三巴 ↔ 'If you are coming down through the narrows of the river Kiang,'
預將書報家 ↔ 'Please let me know beforehand,'
相迎不道遠 ↔ 'And I will come out to meet you,'
直至長風沙 ↔ 'As far as Cho-fu-Sa.'
